correctness.rationale: Exact energy drop after ordered coordinates i,j is a_i²+(a_j-H_ji a_i)². For the constant vector, repeats/nonedges/edges give factors 1,2,2+2c+c² respectively, upper-bounding worst-direction progress of every joint law and forcing edge support. The uniform oriented-edge average equals H[(2+c²)I+(2c/d)A]H/n. For adjacency a in [-d,d], its normalized drop f(a)/n is minimized strictly at a=d because f(a)-f(d)=c(d-a)[dc²+2c(d+a)+2(d-1)]/d≥0, with equality only a=d. Connectedness makes this eigenvalue simple, completing exact global attainment and worst-direction uniqueness. A self-contained exact-rational Python verifier passed 45 graph/coupling cases.

value.rationale: Provides a topology-invariant sharp two-evaluation design valid on every connected regular graph, with a provable necessity of local adjacency among globally minimax schedules even when unrestricted pair laws are allowed. On sparse cycles it gives a sharp 13/8 limit (62.5% more worst-case expected energy decrease) versus unstructured distinct pairs. This gives a motivated structural rule for cheap sequential local solves; not presented as an overall speedup or general convergence theorem.
